description: (0.5.0, Draft) Holder verification of a held artifact (RFC-ACDP-0022 §8), including negatives.

input.note: Use the a2a-001 body, link and Task snapshot artifact as the held artifact unless a scenario says otherwise.

expected.behavior: The holder verifies the body per RFC-ACDP-0001, matches ctx_id, registry and content_hash with the link, finds a valid acdp-a2a-artifact/1 record at metadata["acdp:a2a"], decodes the salt and recomputes parts_hash, artifact_id_hash and name: accept.
One changed byte of a text part, reordered parts, or a dropped mediaType fails step 4 at parts_hash.

scenarios.name: C — wrong, missing or non-canonical salt

expected.behavior: A different salt fails step 4; a salt that is not 43 base64url characters with zero trailing bits fails step 3; a published link without a salt fails step 3 even when salted is false, because the id hashes are always salted.
The a2a-001 link copied onto another artifact fails step 4; a link whose content_hash differs from the body fails step 1.
A record with an extra member is rejected at step 2, not ignored.
A holder that received the artifact forwarded, without the task and context ids, leaves task_id_hash and context_id_hash unchecked; that is not a mismatch. With a wrong known task id, step 5 fails.

Before hashing, a held raw part received in URL-safe or unpadded base64 is re-encoded to standard padded base64; an empty filename or mediaType and any null member are dropped; an absent role or ROLE_UNSPECIFIED reads as ROLE_AGENT. Each verifies (a2a-001 vector 2 P1–P2); hashing the received form unchanged would not.
A retracted body (RFC-ACDP-0013) or a superseded one is reported as such; nothing is pushed to the holder, which checks status itself or through the RFC-ACDP-0018 feed.
A link {failed: true} names no body and verifies nothing.
